summary: Console-hosted paths map to the cloud connector or a local gateway at one choke point in the client, with per-transport keys, self-signed TLS only for local literal hosts, a 100 req/min per-console throttle, actionable 408 and 10 MB errors, UNIFI_READ_ONLY, UNIFI_CONSOLE_ALLOWLIST and a JSONL mutation audit.
reason: Generated commands call /network/integration, /protect/integration and /innerspace/integration, which do not exist on api.ui.com. The generator has no multi-host routing, and generated client.go has no global request mutator, so the seam has to be in doInternal.
validated_outcome: internal/client/unifi_transport_test.go against httptest only. Connector path shape and key behaviour are unverified until a live key exists.
